subject: Billing activation ramp, invoicing cutover and VAT entity handover
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@astrahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay cadence + entity change mid-year (VAT evidence attached)

Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks for the call this morning. We're finalizing our FY26 budget and need to confirm Redwood's invoice cadence for our annual committed spend. A couple of specifics from our side:

- We plan to prepay 60% at contract signature and the remainder distributed as milestones (Q3/Q4). Please confirm whether you can produce two invoices (initial prepay + milestone invoice) vs. monthly drawdown invoices — our AP prefers as few invoices as possible.
- We are also doing an internal entity consolidation: starting 2025-09-01 invoices should be issued to Astra Health Holdings LTD (UK entity) instead of Astra Health Inc (US). We will need your VAT routing and any required certificates to support this cutover.
- Please include sample invoice lines (unit of measure for tokens/embeddings, tax fields) so our procurement team can map to the PO.

Attached: Astra_VAT_registration.pdf (company VAT cert)

Can you propose a practical invoicing and drawdown plan and call out any blockers? We are working to a tight procurement window (PO by 2025-06-30).

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of Finance — Astra Health
finance | Astra Health


From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence + entity change mid-year (VAT evidence attached)

Maria — thanks for the clear notes and the VAT cert. High-level proposal below (we'll attach a sample invoice and a consolidated schedule):

1) Invoicing cadence options (pick one):
   a) Two-invoice approach (recommended for AP simplicity):
      - Invoice 1 (prepay): 60% at signature, covers committed capacity Jan–Aug usage credit.
      - Invoice 2 (milestone): 40% invoiced on 2025-09-01 to Astra Health Holdings LTD (UK) — this will include VAT treatment per your UK entity (we will apply VAT where applicable or zero-rate based on supplied VAT registration).
   b) Monthly drawdown (detailed ledger): one invoice per month showing token/embedding lines and remaining credit. Better for telemetry but more AP work.

2) Entity cutover mechanics:
   - We can issue Invoice 2 to the UK entity. NEED: copy of PO referencing new legal entity or an amendment to PO, and confirmation of billing address plus VAT ID (you've attached the VAT cert which helps).
   - We'll produce a redacted VAT evidence packet for your tax team (we'll include our local VAT registration and the mapping used on the invoice).

3) Operational items (action owners):
   - Redwood (Jonas): generate invoice templates and the proposed schedule (attached: redwood_invoice_sample_v1.pdf, invoice_schedule_Q3-Q4.xlsx).
   - Redwood (Kimberly): confirm bank remit routing and whether we need separate remit for UK entity.
   - Astra (Maria): confirm PO/PO amendment and remit details for the UK entity by 2025-06-30.

If two-invoice approach works for you, we will prepare the DocuSign amendment for the billed entity and run the accounting cutover with our finance ops (Neha will own the ledger change).

Next steps: Kimberly / Neha — can you confirm the bank/wire setup and whether we need a separate billing profile for the UK entity? Maria — if you confirm the two-invoice path, we'll prepare the paperwork today.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Revenue — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@astrahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence + entity change mid-year (VAT evidence attached)

Quick ops note from my side:

- Bank / remit: If we switch invoicing to the UK entity on 2025-09-01, finance needs the full bank remit table (account number, sort code/IBAN, SWIFT). We can support a single remit with an accounting memo to map to the UK ledger, but risk-posting in local currency may require a separate remit if your treasury insists.
- Tax handling: We will zero-rate VAT on Invoice 2 only if your VAT cert demonstrates valid cross-border B2B. Otherwise, tax will be applied per UK rules.
- Internal ops: Neha, we'll need a short runbook to migrate outstanding credit from US to UK ledger for that invoice date.

Attached: invoice_schedule_Q3-Q4.xlsx (draft) and redwood_invoice_sample_v1.pdf

Maria — can you confirm: PO number for the prepay (for Invoice 1) and the intended remit (same bank or new IBAN)? If you confirm today, we can lock invoice templates and have Finance issue Invoice 1 on signature.

-Kimberly
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@astrahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence + entity change mid-year (VAT evidence attached)

On Thu, Jun 19, 2025 at 11:05 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Maria — thanks for the clear notes and the VAT cert. High-level proposal below (we'll attach a sample invoice and a consolidated schedule):
>
> 1) Invoicing cadence options (pick one):
>    a) Two-invoice approach (recommended for AP simplicity):
>       - Invoice 1 (prepay): 60% at signature...

Thanks — we prefer the two-invoice approach. Confirming: PO# AH-2025-789 will cover Invoice 1 (prepay) to Astra Health Inc (US). Remit remains the same for Invoice 1.

For the UK cutover: we'll provide a PO amendment for Invoice 2 to Astra Health Holdings LTD (UK) and send the new remit/IBAN by next week (no later than 2025-06-26). VAT cert attached again for completeness.

Attached: Astra_VAT_registration.pdf

We are comfortable with Redwood preparing the DocuSign amendment. Please proceed with templates and the amendment to change billing entity for the second invoice.

Regards,
Maria
Head of Finance — Astra Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence + entity change mid-year (VAT evidence attached)

Maria — great, thank you. Confirming actions and timeline:

- Redwood will issue Invoice 1 (60% prepay) on receipt of signature/PO (AH-2025-789). Invoice will be to Astra Health Inc (US), remit details as currently on file. Attachment: redwood_invoice_sample_v1.pdf
- We will prepare the DocuSign amendment to switch billing for Invoice 2 to Astra Health Holdings LTD (UK). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/123456789 (will be sent to Maria and procurement).
- Neha will prepare an internal ledger migration runbook to move outstanding credit to the UK invoice date (2025-09-01) and confirm accounting entries.
- Kimberly will wait for IBAN/PO amendment from Astra (target: 2025-06-26).

If there are no blockers I will kick off Finance to create Invoice 1 today so it can be released upon your signature.

Thanks everyone — will follow up once DocuSign is out.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Revenue — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
